## Summary

Describe the contribution and why it is needed.

## Area

- [ ] Firmware
- [ ] Hardware
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test / calibration
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Validation

Explain how the change was built, checked, or measured. Include hardware revision and tool versions where relevant.

## Evidence

Link to source files, logs, datasets, or before/after images.

## Checklist

- [ ] I used my own branch and Git identity.
- [ ] I reviewed the staged diff.
- [ ] I did not include secrets or unrelated personal data.
- [ ] I excluded generated build files.
- [ ] I updated documentation for changed behavior.
- [ ] I labeled unverified claims as targets or reported results.
